records.text: Cleric skill points: Earth's Retribution and Judgment Thunder first, Earth's Grace straight to 10 when learned at 21 (flat gate), then Chain of Torment, Condemnation, Divine Aura, Healing Light, Empyrean Lord's Grace and Light of Regeneration, all to 10 (Metabot, daevaguides, aion2turkiye, mostly mmo-codex; Light of Regeneration: Metabot and aion2turkiye). Attacks before heals, Chain of Torment and Condemnation as fast as allowed and Earth's Grace the level it is learned are two-source; the order between those rules is inferred.

First Daevanion nodes: Nezekan's Condemnation (daevaguides, aion2turkiye) and daevaguides' skill nodes after it; Metabot's Cleric page starts on the Healing Enhancement and Warm Benediction pairs instead.
Cleric learn levels (Divine Aura 3, Chain of Torment 4, Condemnation 8, Bolt 14 and the other actives): your Cleric skill window, Metabot's skill pages (game data) and mmo-codex's unlock table.

Cleric passives at Lv 11, 13, 15, 17, 23 and 25: your skill window shows other art in those cells than Metabot's files, so their names and levels wait for a tooltip screenshot. The guide plans none of them.

Debilitating Mark to 7 and Radiant Recovery to 5 (Metabot; daevaguides 8, aion2turkiye 10): the guide takes 7 and 5 with the last spare points. Bolt to 10 by 38 (daevaguides, aion2turkiye) needs points from quests and Sealed Dungeons on top.

Specialty picks at skill Lv 8: Chain of Torment longer damage over time, Condemnation more damage on fewer targets, Divine Aura AoE, Healing Light +2 uses, Light of Regeneration stronger heal at low HP (mmo-codex, aion2turkiye, daevaguides, skycoach). Earth's Retribution and Judgment Thunder: the sources split, so no pick.
Stat priority while leveling (Attack, Critical Hit): Metabot's leveling build, aion2turkiye, skycoach; Metabot's Cleric page ranks HP, Defense and MP first for a party healer.

Stigmas Earth Punishment, Light of Protection, Noble Aura, Prayer of Amplification (daevaguides, mmo-codex, aion2turkiye; Metabot takes Summon Resurrection for the fourth and puts Earth Punishment third). Earth Punishment to 5 at 22 is two-source; the levels 9 / 5 / 5 / 5 are the guide's split of the 29 shards.
Stigma slots 22 / 27 / 32 / 37; every stigma learnable at 22; shard cost per level (Metabot, allthings.how).
Condemnation and Lightning Strike Scattershot fire only on their conditions (Metabot's skill pages, game data; mmo-codex, daevaguides).
